data.narrative:
Fergani Space is a private-stage aerospace company founded by Selçuk Bayraktar. The Space & Aerospace sector encompasses 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods encounter material constraints. Peer-median multiples cannot be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set; while 14 same-sector companies exist, fewer than three meet tighter cohort filters, rendering sector-wide medians uninformative rather than directional. Public-comp anchoring is similarly inapplicable: the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 24.6x revenue across the six public tickers, but Fergani Space's revenue is not disclosed, precluding P/S multiple application.

Without disclosed revenue or a sufficiently granular peer cohort, conventional quantitative methods do not yield a defensible valuation range. The analysis would require either: (1) disclosure of target revenue to enable public multiple anchoring; (2) identification of at least three same-stage private comparables with known valuations and financial metrics; or (3) bottom-up cash flow or asset-based methodologies using operational data not currently on file. A complete valuation assessment is not supportable from the available data.
